title: FRY9C Instruction Line Item
description: Schema for extracting instruction text for a single line item from an FRY9C instruction document. Each entry pairs a line item reference with its full regulatory instruction text for matching to the form.

line_item_number.description: The line item reference number this instruction applies to, exactly as printed in the heading. Match the bold heading format: 'Item 1.a.(1)(a)', 'Memorandum item M.7.k.', or just '1.a.(1)(a)'. Preserve all dots, parentheses, and the 'Item' or 'Memorandum item' prefix when present. Use consistent formatting to allow matching back to the form's line_item_number field.

mdrm_code.description: The 4-character MDRM code referenced in the instruction, if explicitly mentioned. Examples: '4435', 'B488', 'HT69'. Return null if the instruction does not cite an MDRM code.

mdrm_prefix.description: The prefix before the MDRM code (e.g. 'BHCK', 'BHDM'), if mentioned. Return null if not referenced.

line_item_title.description: The short title of the line item — the bolded or emphasised text at the start of the instruction section. Examples: 'Interest and fee income on loans', 'Loans secured by 1-4 family residential properties', 'Net income (loss)'. Do not include the reference number itself.

instruction_text.description: The complete instruction text for this line item. Include all paragraphs, bullet points, include/exclude lists, cross-references, definitions, and reporting rules. Do not truncate or summarise — capture the full text as written. This is the authoritative guidance used by bank compliance teams.

schedule_name.description: The schedule this instruction belongs to, from the page header. Examples: 'Schedule HI', 'Schedule HC-B', 'Schedule HC-R'. Use the official designation, including any Part qualifier if present.

cross_references.description: All references to other schedules, line items, or glossary entries cited in the instruction text. Examples: ['Schedule HI-B, Part II, item 7', 'Glossary entry for Allowance for Credit Losses', 'Schedule HC, item 12']. Capture them as separate list elements. Return null if none.

reporting_guidance.description: Any reporting conditions, filer-type restrictions, or thresholds mentioned. Examples: 'Report only if total consolidated assets are $5 billion or more', 'Not applicable for savings and loan holding companies', 'Report on a calendar year-to-date basis'. Return null if no special conditions apply.

effective_date.description: The effective date shown in the page footer, in MM/YYYY format. Examples: '03/2024', '12/2024'. Return null if not visible on the page.
